battle.name: 蘇德戰爭
battle.theater: 東線戰場自波羅的海至黑海
battle.brief: 1941年6月22日德軍發動巴巴羅薩行動，蘇德戰爭在歐洲東線全面展開，至1945年5月德軍投降、蘇軍攻入柏林告終，歷時近四年，是二次大戰的主戰場。卡面的1860年加特林機槍並未參戰，但讓後坐力分散於六次射擊的多管設計，正是本役兩軍以機槍火力密度壓制整個師的技術源頭。

kit.name: 加特林機槍
kit.history: 六根管子用人力轉動。它的後坐力分散在六次上，所以能壓住一個師。

countries: 蘇德戰爭自1941年6月22日德軍進攻蘇聯起，至1945年5月8日德軍簽署投降書止，交戰主體是蘇聯與德國，實質是整個軸心國集團與同盟國集團在歐洲東線的全面對抗。德國一方由國防軍最高統帥部統合，陸軍以集群軍為最高戰役單位，巴巴羅薩行動發動時編成北方集群軍群、中央集群軍群與南方集群軍群，並把匈牙利方向的部隊升格為南方集群軍群列為主攻，7月1日再由第6與第17集團軍合組頓河集群軍群專責蘇維埃河南岸。芬蘭以諾曼第元帥領銜，以卡累利阿戰役名義投入三個集團軍級部隊自北線進攻；羅姆尼亞由安東內斯庫政府派出第三、第四集團軍，匈牙利出動第二集團軍，義大利派第八集團軍，另有斯洛伐克與烏斯達拉沙維亞的獨立部隊。法國維希政府與英美在北非、西西里與義大利方向牽制德軍，使德方無法全心用兵東線。蘇聯一方採最高統帥部與國防委員會雙軌運作：1941年6月30日成立國防委員會，史達林任主席，莫洛托夫、伏羅希洛夫、布瓊尼、米高揚、赫魯曉夫、朱可夫、瓦西列夫斯基與沙波什尼可夫為委員；國防人民委員部先由鐵木辛哥主持，7月後由史達林兼攬。紅軍在1941年6月下旬先後組建北方、西北部、西部、中部、西南部與南方等戰略方面軍，1942年5月增設斯摩棱斯克、沃羅涅日、頓涅茨克方面軍，1943年10月全面改為方面軍、集團軍、軍三級制。戰役層面，1942年5月成立第一打擊集團軍，1943年2月第二打擊集團軍，1944年6月第三、第四打擊集團軍，由參謀總長瓦西列夫斯基擬定計劃、史達林核准後實施戰略進攻。英美以租借法案輸送軍火、卡車與航空燃油，1944年6月第二戰場開闢後，德方在東線的兵力被長期釘死，無法西調。
countriesEn: The Soviet-German War ran from the German attack on the Soviet Union on 22 June 1941 to the signing of the German surrender on 8 May 1945; the principal belligerents were the Soviet Union and Germany, and in substance the whole Axis group against the whole Allied group on the Eastern Front in Europe. On the German side the campaign was run through the Wehrmacht high command, the army fighting with army groups as its highest operational formation: at the opening of Operation Barbarossa there were Army Groups North, Centre and South, and the forces in the Hungarian direction were raised to Army Group South to serve as the main effort; on 1 July the 6th and 17th Armies were combined into Army Group Don with responsibility for the south bank of the Soviet river. Finland under Marshal Mannerheim committed three corps-scale formations from the northern flank under the name of the Karelian Isthmus operation; Romania under the Antonescu government sent in the 3rd and 4th Armies, Hungary the 2nd Army, Italy the 8th Army, and there were independent Slovak and Ustaše formations as well. Vichy France and Britain and the United States tied down German forces in North Africa, Sicily and Italy, so that Germany could never concentrate wholly on the Eastern Front. On the Soviet side command ran on two parallel tracks, the Stavka and the State Defence Committee: the State Defence Committee was formed on 30 June 1941 with Stalin in the chair and Molotov, Voroshilov, Budonny, Mikoyan, Khrushchev, Zhukov, Vasilevsky and Shaposhnikov as members; the People's Commissariat of Defence was first headed by Timoshenko and from July taken over by Stalin himself. The Red Army established the Northern, North-Western, Western, Central, South-Western and Southern strategic fronts in the latter half of June 1941, added the Smolensk, Voronezh and Donets fronts in May 1942, and in October 1943 reorganised entirely into the three-tier system of front, army and corps. At the operational level the First Shock Group was formed in May 1942, the Second in February 1943 and the Third and Fourth in June 1944, with plans drawn up by the chief of the General Staff Vasilevsky and approved by Stalin before the strategic offensives were launched. Britain and the United States supplied arms, trucks and aviation fuel under the Lend-Lease Act, and after the opening of the second front in June 1944 the German forces on the Eastern Front were pinned there for the rest of the war and could not be shifted west.
people: 決定東線走勢的人物在兩邊各有其權重。德國方面，希特勒於1940年12月5日以第二十一號指令批准東方方案，隨後把巴巴羅薩的發動日從原定的1941年5月一再押後；開戰首日他仍在上巴伐利亞的指揮所，直到戰局不利才於7月初移駐狼穴。國防軍最高統帥部長官凱特爾主持日常統帥，陸軍參謀長哈德勒主張不修邊、不分兵、連續直取的巴巴羅薩原案；裝甲兵老將古德里安主張集中裝甲縱隊直插斯摩棱斯克，他的前景第2裝甲集團軍在1941年12月初已逼近莫斯科城下，卻因燃料耗盡而停滯。曼施泰因於1942年8月提出鐮刀割方案，以第57裝甲師自羅斯托夫向頓河下游突進，切斷蘇軍第62與第51集團軍的補給線；他在斯大林格勒救援失敗後出任頓河集群軍群總司令，1943年2月因哈爾科夫戰敗被解職。莫德爾接掌中央集群軍群，在庫爾斯克把防禦縱深由數公里拉到一百公里以上，把德軍精銳裝甲師當作反擊預備隊使用。賴歇豪與赫特分任南方與北方集群軍群總司令；保羅斯以第6集團軍在斯大林格勒作戰，1943年1月31日被俘；參謀長蔡茨勒在1941年6月23日把明斯克大包圍的情報上報，並得到希特勒「部隊在哪裡」的質問。蘇聯方面，1941年7月3日史達林以廣播發表寸步不讓的命令，7月7日成立國防委員會，11月7日在紅場舉行閱兵。朱可夫在斯摩棱斯克解圍、1941年12月5日指揮莫斯科反攻，並先後統籌天王星、庫爾斯克、巴巴羅薩與柏林戰役。瓦西列夫斯基自1942年起任參謀總長，是天王星與巴巴羅薩方案的主要擬稿人，與安東諾夫共同主持參謀作業。科涅夫指揮庫爾斯克南線的魯明采夫作戰、1944年羅斯托夫與頓巴斯攻勢以及維斯瓦—奧得河攻勢；羅科索夫斯基以奧廖爾攻勢成名，率第2白俄羅斯方面軍執行巴巴羅薩的波羅的海方向戰役；馬利諾夫斯基以第2近衛坦克集團軍在斯大林格勒救援，後任第3烏克蘭方面軍司令攻克基輔與布加勒斯特；托爾布欣率第3烏克蘭方面軍越過喀爾巴阡山入匈牙利，攻取布達佩斯直抵維也納；戈沃羅夫死守列寧格勒並在1944年發動諾沃哥羅德方向的的反擊；瓦圖京在沃羅涅日方向陣亡，1944年4月死於車禍。
peopleEn: The men who decided the course of the Eastern Front carried weight on both sides. On the German side Hitler approved Plan Ost through Directive No. 21 of 5 December 1940 and then deferred the launching date of Barbarossa, originally set for May 1941, again and again; on the first day of the war he was still at the headquarters in Upper Bavaria and moved to the Wolf's Lair only in early July once the situation turned. Wehrmacht high command chief Keitel presided over the day-to-day conduct of the war, army chief of staff Halder argued for the original Barbarossa plan of undivided, uninterrupted advance, and the old armoured specialist Guderian pressed for concentrating the panzer columns on Smolensk; his 2nd Panzer Army had reached the outskirts of Moscow by early December 1941 and stalled for want of fuel. Manstein proposed the sickle cut in August 1942, driving the 57th Panzer Division from Rostov toward the lower Don to cut the supply lines of the Soviet 62nd and 51st Armies; after the relief of Stalingrad failed he took command of Army Group Don and was dismissed in February 1943 after the defeat at Kharkov. Model took over Army Group Centre and at Kursk stretched the defensive depth from a few kilometres to more than a hundred, holding the best German panzer divisions as a counter-attack reserve. Reichenau and Hoth commanded Army Groups South and North; Paulus fought with the 6th Army at Stalingrad and was captured on 31 January 1943; and the quartermaster general Zeitzler reported the encirclement of Minsk on 23 June 1941 and was met with Hitler's question where the rest of the army was. On the Soviet side Stalin broadcast the order not to give ground on 3 July 1941, the State Defence Committee was created on 7 July, and the parade on Red Square was held on 7 November. Zhukov unblocked Smolensk, commanded the Moscow counter-offensive on 5 December 1941, and later directed the Uranus, Kursk, Bagration and Berlin operations. Vasilevsky, chief of the General Staff from 1942, was the principal author of the Uranus and Bagration plans and ran the staff work with Antonov. Konev led the Rumyantsev operation on the southern shoulder of Kursk, the Rostov and Donbas offensive of 1944 and the Vistula-Oder offensive; Rokossovsky made his name with the Oryol offensive and led the 2nd Belorussian Front in the Baltic direction during Bagration; Malinovsky came to prominence with the 2nd Guards Tank Army in the relief of Stalingrad and later took the 3rd Ukrainian Front through Kiev and Bucharest; Tolbukhin carried the 3rd Ukrainian Front over the Carpathians into Hungary, took Budapest and reached Vienna; Govorov held Leningrad and counter-attacked in the Novgorod direction in 1944; and Vatutin was killed in the Voronezh direction, dying in a car accident in April 1944.
kits: 卡面那件1860年的加特林機槍沒有出現在蘇德戰場的戰壕裡，它真正的戰史停在更早的年代：美國南北戰爭期間它由水手與黑人炮手操作，1870至1880年代俄國也向美國訂購一批，1877至1878年俄土戰爭的普列夫納會戰中被大量架在塹壕與砲位上，1904至1905年日俄戰爭時俄軍又把它架在旅順要塞與滿洲鐵路沿線，其中一部分在戰後為日軍所獲。加特林機槍真正的後裔並不是戰壕裡的機槍，而是它確立的原理：由多根槍管輪替射擊、把後坐力分散在多次射擊之中、用人力或牲畜帶動連續供彈，並以極高射速製造足以壓制一整個師的火力密度。1941至1945年真正在東線開火的是它的這一輩後代。德軍主力是MG 34與MG 42輕機槍，MG 42射速每分鐘六百至九百發，採用滾柱式閉鎖與電氣觸發，機身可快速換槍管，每班配一挺，師級輕機槍數量以數百計，另有MG 08/15與MG 08重機槍守備要地，MG 42班組還配上面包手榴彈發射器消除火力死角。蘇軍核心是Maxim M1910/30水冷式重機槍與德格佳廖夫DP輕機槍，DP用四十七發圓盤彈匣，射速每分鐘五百至六百發，架在雙腳架上作班用輕機槍使用，另有由哈FN M1910改裝的DP-27與DS-39；步兵以莫辛—納甘特M1891/30步槍配PU瞄準鏡為主，另有半自動的SVT-40狙擊槍與TT-33手槍。美軍的M1917與M1919水冷式勃朗寧機槍同樣出自加特林一脈，M1919在1942年後大量經租借法案運抵蘇聯並被仿製，1943年後成為紅軍制式武器之一。戰車方面蘇軍有T-34、KV-1、T-70與IS-2，輔以SU-76i、SU-85與SU-152自行火炮，德軍有III號、IV號、虎式坦克與斐迪南、四號突擊砲。火砲方面蘇軍以M1943式76毫米師屬炮、152毫米M1931式榴彈炮與76毫米團屬炮為骨幹，德軍以88毫米高射炮兼任反戰車任務並配150毫米突擊砲。航空方面蘇軍有裝甲量大的IL-2對地攻擊機與佩-2轟炸機，輔以米格-3、拉-7、雅克-1、雅克-3與雅克-9戰鬥機；德軍有Ju 87俯衝轟炸機、Me 210與Fw 190戰鬥機及Bf 109。火箭炮BM-13自1941年即投入使用。運輸方面，蘇軍1941年仍靠數百萬匹馬匹、大車與鐵路維持補給，1942年後依靠租借運到的逾四十萬輛卡車以及大量機車與罐車；德軍東線依賴挽馬大車並把鐵路推至前線，最遠處的補給線超過一千公里。
kitsEn: The Gatling gun of 1860 shown on the card never stood in a trench on the Eastern Front; its real history belongs to an earlier age. During the American Civil War it was crewed by sailors and black gunners, Russia ordered a batch from the United States in the 1870s and 1880s, and it was mounted in large numbers in the trenches and batteries around Plevna in the Russo-Turkish War of 1877-1878; in the Russo-Japanese War of 1904-1905 the Russian army again emplaced it at Port Arthur and along the Manchurian railway, and some pieces fell to the Japanese after the war. The true descendants of the Gatling were not the machine guns in the trenches but the principles it established: several barrels firing in rotation, the recoil spread over many shots, continuous feed turned by hand or animal power, and a rate of fire capable of producing enough density to pin down an entire division. What actually fired on the Eastern Front from 1941 to 1945 belonged to that generation. The German mainstay was the MG 34 and the MG 42 light machine gun, the MG 42 firing six hundred to nine hundred rounds a minute on a roller-delayed action with an electrical trigger, quick-change barrels, one gun to each squad and several hundred light machine guns to the division, with MG 08/15 and MG 08 heavy machine guns manning fixed positions and MG 42 groups carrying the Schiessbecher pan grenade launcher to kill the blind spots. The Soviet core was the Maxim M1910/30 water-cooled heavy machine gun and the Degtyaryov DP light machine gun, the latter with a forty-seven round pan magazine, a rate of fire of five hundred to six hundred rounds a minute and a bipod that let it be used as a squad light machine gun; there were also the DP-27 and DS-39 converted from the FN M1910. Soviet infantry relied on the Mosin-Nagant M1891/30 rifle with a PU scope, with the semi-automatic SVT-40 sniper rifle and the TT-33 pistol alongside. The American M1917 and M1919 water-cooled Brownings came from the same Gatling line, and from 1942 the M1919 was shipped to the Soviet Union in bulk under Lend-Lease and copied there, becoming one of the Red Army's standard weapons after 1943. On armour the Soviets fielded the T-34, KV-1, T-70 and IS-2 with the SU-76i, SU-85 and SU-152 self-propelled guns, while Germany had the Panzer III and IV, the Tiger and the Ferdinand and StuG IV assault guns. In artillery the Soviet army leaned on the M1943 76 mm divisional gun, the M1931 152 mm howitzer and the 76 mm regimental gun, Germany used its 88 mm flak gun in the anti-tank role and the 150 mm assault gun. In the air the Soviets flew the heavily armoured IL-2 ground attack aircraft and the Pe-2 bomber, supported by MiG-3, La-7, Yak-1, Yak-3 and Yak-9 fighters, against the Ju 87 dive bomber, Me 210 and Fw 190 fighters and Bf 109 on the German side, and the BM-13 rocket launcher was in service from 1941. For transport the Soviet army still relied in 1941 on millions of horses, carts and the railways, and after 1942 on the more than four hundred thousand trucks delivered under Lend-Lease together with large numbers of locomotives and tank wagons; Germany depended on horse-drawn wagons and pushed its railways up to the front, the longest supply line running more than a thousand kilometres.
tactics: 東線的戰術史是一部由機槍火力密度逼出來的技術史。1941年巴巴羅薩的戰法是德軍的楔形與鍋底：裝甲集群以密集隊形楔入步兵縱隊側翼，炮兵集中火力與俯衝轟炸機臨空支援同步展開，戰役縱深一氣呵成，目標是各戰略方面軍的縱深被連續剝削、整建制被合圍殲滅。蘇軍1941年的反擊多屬臨時拼湊，縱深戰役的原則雖已寫入軍令，卻缺乏足夠的汽車、馬匹與通信把數十萬人送進縱深，於是在包圍圈中大量被俘。1942年德軍在東線佔優，靠的是步兵分隊以機槍與手榴彈逐段清理塹壕的戰術，以及在戰術縱深以守舊陣地拖住蘇軍。蘇軍的轉折是把壓制敵方機槍射界寫進1943年的步兵戰鬥條令：進攻前以炮火準備和航空兵火力壓制敵陣，逐次投入步兵吃下一個又一個縱深，再由坦克集團軍與空軍把戰果擴大為戰術突破。1942年11月19日的天王星作戰是配合的典範：第3與第4烏克蘭方面軍自突頂兩翼對進，羅科索夫斯基的第16集團軍與崔可夫的第62集團軍在頓涅茨克方向對上德軍，炮火準備僅數十分鐘，蘇軍在突破口兩側投入了壓倒性的炮兵密度，裝甲軍在突破後一日內即擴大戰果數十公里。庫爾斯克戰役是防禦技術的頂點：突出部正面寬約二百公里，蘇軍縱深構築多道地帶與反斜面陣地，德軍以裝甲集群自南北兩面對進，並在裝甲團之間插入步兵掩護楔子，雙方僵持八天後蘇軍的戰術突破仍被挫敗。巴巴羅薩的戰術在1944年成熟：蘇軍以四個方面軍在四個戰區同時發動，用偽裝與假部隊掩護調動，炮兵與航空兵同時集中，坦克集團軍連續打穿三個作戰縱深，一個多月推進約六百公里。冬季方面，1941至1942年紅軍以滑雪旅深入雪原迂迴德軍側翼，並靠拉多加湖上的冰面道路維持列寧格勒的地面補給。
tacticsEn: The tactical history of the Eastern Front is a technical history forced along by the density of machine gun fire. The 1941 Barbarossa method was the German wedge and cauldron: armoured columns drove into the flank of infantry columns in close formation while massed artillery and dive bombers supported in the same beat, operational depth was stripped in one continuous sweep, and the aim was to destroy whole formations in encirclement. The Soviet counter-offensives of 1941 were largely improvised; the principles of deep operations were already written into the manuals, but there were not enough lorries, horses or communications to carry hundreds of thousands of men into depth, and masses were taken prisoner inside the pockets. German superiority in 1942 rested on the squad clearing trench line by line with machine gun and hand grenade, and on holding the old positions in tactical depth to hold the Soviets in place. The Soviet turning point was to write the suppression of enemy machine gun arcs into the 1943 infantry regulations: before the attack, artillery preparation and aviation were used to pin the enemy positions, infantry was fed in step by step to eat depth one after another, and tank armies and air force then widened the tactical breach into an operational one. The Uranus operation of 19 November 1942 is the archetype of such coordination: the 3rd and 4th Ukrainian Fronts closed in from the two flanks of the salient while Rokossovsky's 16th Army and Chuikov's 62nd Army took the enemy in the Donets direction; the artillery preparation lasted only tens of minutes, the Soviets put overwhelming artillery density into the two shoulders of the breach, and within a day the armoured armies had widened the success by tens of kilometres. The battle of Kursk was the summit of defensive technique: the salient was about two hundred kilometres wide, the Soviets built several belts and reverse-slope positions in depth, Germany attacked with armoured groups from north and south and inserted infantry covering wedges between the panzer regiments, and after eight days the Soviet tactical breakthrough was still frustrated. The tactics of Bagration came to maturity in 1944: four fronts attacked simultaneously in four separate sectors, movements were masked by camouflage and dummy formations, artillery and aviation were concentrated simultaneously, and the tank armies broke through three depths of battle in succession, advancing some six hundred kilometres in little more than a month. In winter, between 1941 and 1942 the Red Army sent ski troops deep into the snowfields to turn the German flank, and kept a land supply to Leningrad open over the ice road across Lake Ladoga.
data: 可核的數字最能說明這場戰爭的規模。巴巴羅薩行動發動時，德方及其盟軍投入兵力約三百萬至三百八十萬人，坦克與突擊砲約三千五百輛，飛機約三千架，進攻正面寬約二千九百公里。蘇軍1941年6月全軍裝甲約二萬二千輛，其中可堪現代作戰的KV-1與T-34合計不足四千輛。1941年內蘇軍損失軍人約四百三十萬（陣亡約一百零八萬、被俘約一百三十萬、其餘為傷者），損失坦克與自行火炮約一萬二千至一萬五千輛，損失飛機近兩萬架；整個戰爭蘇軍軍人總損失約八百六十萬人，其中陣亡約二百七十六萬。德軍在東線的死亡人數一般引述約三百四十萬。斯大林格勒一役被包圍的第6集團軍約三十萬人，最終約九萬人突圍返回，其餘大部被俘。庫爾斯克戰役蘇軍投入兵力約一百三十三萬，德軍與盟軍約七十八萬，坦克與突擊砲合計逾八千輛，蘇軍炮火準備持續約八天，戰役自1943年7月5日打到8月23日。巴巴羅薩作戰蘇軍投入約二百四十萬人，德軍中央集團軍群損失約四十萬至五十萬人，蘇軍一個多月推進約六百公里。攻入柏林的戰役蘇軍投入約二百五十萬人，德軍守軍約四十萬至五十萬人，蘇軍此役傷亡約七萬八千人。產量方面，蘇聯1943年造出坦克與自行火炮約二萬四千輛、飛機約三萬五千架，1944年分別增至約二萬九千輛與四萬架。租借法案運抵蘇聯的物資總值約一百一十三億美元，包括卡車與吉普車逾四十萬輛、飛機約五萬架、坦克與自行火炮約一萬二千七百輛，以及大量糧食、機車與罐車。
dataEn: The verifiable figures show the scale of this war better than anything. At the opening of Operation Barbarossa Germany and its allies committed about three to three and a half million men, roughly three thousand five hundred tanks and assault guns, about three thousand aircraft and a front of some two thousand nine hundred kilometres. The Soviet army had about twenty-two thousand tanks in June 1941, of which the genuinely modern KV-1 and T-34 together numbered fewer than four thousand. During 1941 Soviet military losses were roughly 4.3 million men, about 1.08 million killed, about 1.3 million captured and the remainder wounded, together with the loss of some twelve to fifteen thousand tanks and self-propelled guns and close to twenty thousand aircraft; over the whole war Soviet military losses were about 8.6 million men, of whom around 2.76 million were killed. German deaths on the Eastern Front are usually put at about 3.4 million. At Stalingrad the encircled 6th Army numbered some 300,000 men, of whom roughly 90,000 broke out and most of the rest were taken prisoner. At Kursk the Soviets committed about 1.33 million men against some 780,000 Germans and allies, with more than eight thousand tanks and assault guns between them, an artillery preparation lasting about eight days, and the battle running from 5 July to 23 August 1943. In Bagration the Soviets committed about 2.4 million men, German Army Group Centre lost some 400,000 to 500,000 men, and the Soviet advance covered about six hundred kilometres in a little over a month. In the battle for Berlin about 2.5 million Soviet troops went in against 400,000 to 500,000 German defenders, with Soviet casualties of roughly 78,000. On output, the Soviet Union built about twenty-four thousand tanks and self-propelled guns and some thirty-five thousand aircraft in 1943, rising in 1944 to about twenty-nine thousand and forty thousand respectively. Lend-Lease delivered goods worth about 11.3 billion dollars, including more than four hundred thousand trucks and jeeps, roughly fifty thousand aircraft, some twelve thousand seven hundred tanks and self-propelled guns, and large quantities of food, locomotives and tank wagons.
cause: 遠因是希特勒的生存空間構想與德國的資源焦慮。納粹政權需要東方的糧食、鐵礦、原油與木材來支撐擴張的軍備，而這一切都要從蘇聯的土地上取得；1939年8月23日的蘇德互不侵犯條約及其秘密議定書把東歐劃成勢力範圍，9月28日的附加議定書又讓蘇聯取得波蘭東部、芬蘭、愛沙尼亞、拉脫維亞與比薩拉比亞，並推動蘇聯對芬蘭動手，芬蘭戰爭之後蘇聯向德國供應的穀物、石油與礦石仍以百萬噸計，說明德方原本打算讓蘇聯成為其原料基地。同盟國集團的擴張使蘇德之間再也沒有緩衝：1940年9月義大利、日本與德國結成三國同盟，1941年3月南斯拉夫政變讓軸心國分裂，4月南斯拉夫被占，6月蘇聯接著進入波蘭，匈牙利、羅姆尼亞與斯洛伐克於6月22日同時向蘇聯宣戰，軸心國包圍圈的雛形就此完成。英法在1939年三國談判中對蘇聯步步退讓，1939至1940年的冬季戰爭更使蘇聯取得波羅的海的冰封港口，1940年6月法國崩潰後英國孤立地依賴法國，歐洲大陸再無可以借力的力量，德國遂取得東進的空間。直接原因則是希特勒在戰略與政治上的兩項判斷：其一，他認定蘇維埃政權是德國最兇惡的敵人，必須在美國坐大之前將其徹底消滅，因此第二十一號指令把巴巴羅薩的目標定在征服蘇聯並直取高加索油田；其二，他相信英國不會在蘇聯遭攻擊後開戰，而蘇聯在1939至1941年之間已與柏林簽訂條約、並在芬蘭問題上與德國合作，使他誤判蘇聯不會插手。1941年夏，德方情報部門發現蘇軍正沿波羅的海岸大量集結，希特勒終於在6月22日發動巴巴羅薩行動，把一場原定速戰速決的戰役推成四年消耗戰。
causeEn: The remote cause was Hitler's idea of Lebensraum and German anxiety about resources. The Nazi regime needed grain, iron ore, crude oil and timber from the east to sustain an expanding war economy, and all of it had to be taken from Soviet territory. The Molotov-Ribbentrop Pact of 23 August 1939 with its secret protocol divided eastern Europe into spheres of influence; the supplementary protocol of 28 September 1939 gave the Soviet Union eastern Poland, Finland, Estonia, Latvia and Bessarabia and pushed it into Finland, and after the Winter War the Soviet Union still supplied Germany with grain, oil and ore on a scale of millions of tonnes, which shows that Berlin had intended the Soviet Union to serve as its raw material base. The expansion of the Axis left no buffer between the two: in September 1940 Italy, Japan and Germany formed the Tripartite Pact, the coup in Yugoslavia in March 1941 split the Axis and Yugoslavia was occupied in April, the Soviet Union entered Poland in June, and Hungary, Romania and Slovakia all declared war on the Soviet Union on 22 June 1941, completing the outline of an encirclement. In the tripartite talks of 1939 Britain and France retreated step by step from the Soviet Union, and the Winter War of 1939-1940 gave the Soviets the ice-free Baltic ports; after the collapse of France in June 1940 Britain stood alone with the continent beyond reach, and Germany obtained room to advance east. The immediate causes were two of Hitler's strategic and political judgements. First, he held that the Soviet state was the most dangerous enemy of Germany and had to be destroyed before the United States grew strong, so Directive No. 21 set the object of Barbarossa as the defeat of the Soviet Union and a thrust to the oilfields of the Caucasus. Second, he believed Britain would not enter the war after the Soviet Union was attacked, and that the Soviet Union, bound by the pact of 1939-1941 and co-operating with Germany over Finland, would not intervene. In the summer of 1941 German intelligence found the Red Army massing along the Baltic shore, and on 22 June Hitler launched Barbarossa, turning a campaign planned for speed into a war of four years' attrition.
impact: 東線的後果從軍事、經濟到地緣政治都改寫了二十世紀的樣貌。軍事上，蘇德戰爭吸走了德軍約四分之三的可戰鬥兵力，消滅了德軍絕大部分坦克、火炮與摩托化部隊，第6集團軍是德國陸軍史上被完整消滅的最大建制，中央集群軍群在巴巴羅薩作戰中被打崩，德國的戰爭機器在兩年之內被消耗殆盡，盟軍才能在諾曼底之後以絕對兵力作戰。蘇聯方面則在戰時把工業重心整體東移，1941年下半年起大批企業與技術人員被疏散到烏拉爾、西伯利亞與中亞，鐵路軍用運力與汽車運輸被壓到極限，最終以總動員支撐了工業總量在戰時數倍增長，也由此奠定了蘇聯戰後以重工業與裝甲兵為核心的軍事體制。人的方面，紅軍在四年之間耗盡了1941年以前四十年積累的軍事經驗與幹部，戰後軍隊嚴重缺員，軍制改革與戰役理論的重建成為1944至1946年最艱難的工作。國際格局上，東線的勝負直接決定了歐洲的_partition與戰後秩序：波蘭東疆、但澤與西普魯士歸入波羅的海沿岸，蘇聯取得波蘭東部，1945年2月的雅爾達會議把德國分區佔領與波蘭邊界寫進同盟國的安排，戰後的東歐衛星國體系與冷戰前沿由此形成。德國戰敗的同時，蘇聯把勢力伸入波羅的海與黑海，收回愛沙尼亞、拉脫維亞與立陶宛，並取得別列津斯克這樣原本屬於波蘭的通道，使德國本土與東歐的陸路聯繫從此多了一道必須穿越的邊界。
impactEn: The consequences of the Eastern Front reshaped the twentieth century in military, economic and geopolitical terms. Militarily the war absorbed about three quarters of the German armed forces, destroyed the great majority of German tanks, artillery and motorised formations, wiped out the 6th Army which was the largest formation ever annihilated in the German army's history, and shattered Army Group Centre in Bagration; the German war machine was exhausted within two years, which allowed the Allies to fight with overwhelming strength after Normandy. For the Soviet Union the war meant the wholesale eastward relocation of industry: from the second half of 1941 enterprises and skilled personnel were evacuated to the Urals, Siberia and Central Asia, railway military capacity and motor transport were pushed to the limit, and a total mobilisation ultimately supported a several-fold growth of industrial output, which laid the foundation of the post-war Soviet military system built around heavy industry and armour. In human terms the Red Army spent the accumulated experience and cadre of the previous four decades in four years, and the army that emerged was severely short of men, making reform of the military system and the rebuilding of operational theory the hardest work of 1944 to 1946. Internationally the outcome of the Eastern Front directly determined the partition of Europe and the post-war order: the eastern territories of Poland, Danzig and East Prussia went to the Baltic coast, the Soviet Union took eastern Poland, the Yalta Conference of February 1945 wrote the division of Germany and the Polish border into the Allied arrangements, and the satellite system of Eastern Europe and the frontier of the Cold War took shape from this. Alongside German defeat the Soviet Union pushed its power into the Baltic and the Black Sea, took back Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania, and obtained the Berezina corridor and other passages that had belonged to Poland, so that the land connection between Germany and eastern Europe henceforth had to cross a frontier that could be closed.
result: 結果是德軍在歐洲大陸被徹底擊潰。1945年1月12日至2月2日的維斯瓦—奧得河攻勢中，蘇軍自維斯瓦河一路推進到奧得河，前進約五百公里，切斷了德軍A集團軍群與中央集團軍群的聯繫；4月16日柏林戰役打響，蘇聯以三個方面軍自南北兩面夾擊，5月2日德軍柏林指揮部投降；4月30日夜至5月1日凌晨，紅軍戰士把勝利旗插上國會大廈，希特勒當日自盡。5月7日凌晨德軍代表在蘭斯簽署無條件投降書，5月8日至9日在柏林卡羅爾霍夫再次簽署，蘇方以5月9日為勝利日，歐洲戰事至此結束；庫爾蘭口袋的殘餘守軍在5月11日放下武器，義大利戰線與其他戰區的零星戰鬥持續到5月底。結果的殘酷一面在數字裡：德軍在東線被擊斃約三百四十萬人，蘇聯紅軍傷亡約八百六十萬人，被德軍俘走的蘇軍士兵逾五百七十萬，戰後返回祖國的約一百八十萬。1945年8月蘇聯依雅爾達安排出兵中國東北，關東軍崩潰，蘇軍俘獲日軍逾五十萬；同年9月《日本投降書》簽署，戰爭的另一半同時收束。從歐洲看，蘇德戰爭的勝利者是蘇聯，但勝利並不等於太平：德國被分區佔領，東歐變成新的勢力範圍，一個以常備軍與總動員經驗為基礎的軍事強權自此在歐洲大陸東部站住腳跟。
resultEn: The result was the complete destruction of the German army in Europe. In the Vistula-Oder offensive from 12 January to 2 February 1945 the Soviet armies advanced some five hundred kilometres from the Vistula to the Oder, cutting the link between Army Groups A and Centre; the battle for Berlin opened on 16 April with three Soviet fronts converging from north and south, and on 2 May the German command in Berlin capitulated; during the night of 30 April and the early hours of 1 May a Red Army banner was raised over the Reichstag, and Hitler took his own life that same day. German representatives signed the unconditional surrender at Reims in the early hours of 7 May, and it was signed again in Berlin-Karlshorst on 8 and 9 May, the Soviet Union observing 9 May as the day of victory, and the fighting in Europe came to an end; the remnants in the Courland pocket laid down their arms on 11 May, and scattered resistance in Italy and other theatres lasted to the end of the month. The cruel side of the result is visible in the figures: about 3.4 million Germans were killed on the Eastern Front, Soviet military casualties came to some 8.6 million, more than 5.7 million Soviet soldiers were taken prisoner by the Germans and about 1.8 million of them made it home. In August 1945 the Soviet Union entered Manchuria in accordance with the Yalta arrangements, the Kwantung Army collapsed and Soviet forces took more than half a million Japanese prisoners; the Instrument of Surrender of Japan followed in September 1945 and the other half of the war closed at the same time. From a European point of view the Soviet Union was the winner of the Soviet-German War, but victory was not peace: Germany was divided into occupation zones, eastern Europe became a new sphere of influence, and a military power schooled in standing armies and in total mobilisation took its stand in the east of the European continent.
